confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on aggregator and blog estimates that disagree and are partly dated (Expatistan cocktail data was last updated January 2024), so treat them as approximate. Wine has no Udaipur-specific source; it is set at roughly 2.5 times the beer anchor, the local beer-to-wine relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the regional context; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. FX: the 0.6720 USD_PER_AUD figure for 2026-11-18 was surfaced by a third-party aggregator as an RBA reading, and I could not confirm it on rba.gov.au, so verify it against the RBA F11.1 table before relying on it. No RBA observation for 2026-11-19 was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: South Asian Indian tourist cities, with Udaipur's price levels taken from aggregator and blog figures for food, drink and budget lodging, cross-checked against general knowledge of Rajasthan tourist cities.
